sentences.en: Nuclear power plants are dangerous, not to mention nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 核电站就很危险了，更不用说核武器了。

sentences.en: Jane can play the violin, not to mention the guitar.
sentences.zh: 简会拉小提琴，更别提吉他了。

sentences.en: He has many foreign stamps, not to mention Japanese ones.
sentences.zh: 他有很多外国邮票，更别说日本的了。

senses.zh: 提到，谈到；提名，推荐；传令嘉奖，提名表扬
提及，说起，写上一笔；提名表扬
